name: Radio Group
summary: A radio group is a fieldset, a legend, and native radios that share one name. Use it for one answer out of a few, where all the options should be visible at once. The shared name is what makes it a group: one tab stop for the set, and arrow keys that move and choose in one action.
demoNote: Tab into any group and press the arrow keys: they move and select in one action, and Tab then leaves the whole group as a single stop. None of it is scripted.

contract.useWhen: One answer out of a few, where the arrows both move and choose.
keyboard: native: one stop for the whole group, at the checked option
native: next option, and selects it — moving is choosing
native: previous option, and selects it. Both wrap
states: invalid — aria-invalid=true on each input, set only while the error shows
failureModes: no shared name attribute, so they are not a group and the arrows do nothing
role=radiogroup on a fieldset that already is one
a div styled to look like a legend, which is not the name
one option pre-checked with no sensible default, hiding that nothing was chosen
arrows expected to only move focus, the way they would in a toolbar
